article.title: The UK was right to sanction Israeli settlements. Now it must do more to protect Palestinians under occupation.
article.author: Rohan Talbot and Medical Aid for Palestinians
article.content: In a historic move, the UK banned trade with Israeli settlements – a major step towards accountability for Israeli crimes. But it's not enough while Palestinians face daily state violence, harsh movement restrictions, and are still denied access to basic healthcare.
